*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/divadbaroon/Projects/claude-plugins/experiments/compaction_log.py
+"""Every compaction across local Claude Code sessions -> compaction_log.csv."""
+import csv, glob, json, os
+
+ROOT = os.path.expanduser("~/.claude/projects")
+
+
+def compactions(path):
+    with open(path) as f:
+        for line in f:
+            rec = json.loads(line)
+            if rec.get("type") == "system" and rec.get("subtype") == "compact_boundary":
+                m = rec.get("compactMetadata", {})
+                yield rec["timestamp"], m.get("trigger"), m.get("preTokens")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    rows = []
+    for p in glob.glob(f"{ROOT}/*/*.jsonl"):
+        sid = os.path.basename(p)[:-6]
+        for ts, trig, pre in compactions(p):
+            rows.append({"session": sid, "project": os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(p)), "ts": ts, "trigger": trig, "pre_tokens": pre})
+    with open("experiments/compaction_log.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
+        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=["session", "project", "ts", "trigger", "pre_tokens"]); w.writeheader(); w.writerows(rows)
+    auto = sum(r["trigger"] == "auto" for r in rows)
+    print(f"{len(rows)} compactions in {len({r['session'] for r in rows})} sessions; auto {auto}, manual {len(rows) - auto}")
*** End Patch
